heading_en: Amount of Credit Risk-Weighted Assets for the Dilution Risk Portion of Purchased Receivables
summary_ja: 購入債権の希薄化リスク相当部分の信用リスク・アセットの額は、PDをEL_{dilution}、LGDを100%、マチュリティを一年として算出する。
summary_en: Credit risk-weighted assets for the dilution risk portion are calculated with PD equal to EL_{dilution}, LGD of 100%, the relevant EAD_{dilution}, and a maturity of one year.
paragraphs: Article 129, paragraph (1) applies mutatis mutandis to the calculation of the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the dilution risk portion of purchased receivables. In this case, the phrase "amount of credit risk-weighted assets" in that paragraph shall be deemed to be replaced with "amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the dilution risk portion".
The PD used in the calculation under the preceding paragraph shall be EL_{dilution}.
The LGD used in the calculation under paragraph (1) shall be 100%.
The EAD used in the calculation under paragraph (1) shall be EAD_{dilution} for purchased corporate, etc. exposures or EAD_{dilution} for purchased retail exposures.
The maturity used in the calculation under paragraph (1) shall be one year.
